	if targetPlayer == player then return false end
	
	-- Check standard Roblox Team property
	if player.Team and targetPlayer.Team then
		if targetPlayer.Team == player.Team then
			return false -- Same team, do not attack!
		end

	-- Check for Team/Faction attributes or group configs commonly used in games
	if player:GetAttribute("Team") and targetPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") then

local function makeDraggable(guiObject)
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPosition

    local function updatePosition(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end

    guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = guiObject.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    guiObject.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        -- The payload checks MouseButton1 here rather than MouseMovement.
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)
end

end
